headline: Annual $5,000 stipend for each school committee member recommended to city council
summary: The $5,000 per member amount is already in this year's budget and could be moved to another line. Pay would not start until 2028, the discussion said. The city council must still approve the stipend. Three items numbered 26-681 through 26-683 were also accepted together.
decisions: Approved a $5,000 per member figure for a school committee stipend on a roll call, with four yes and two no votes recorded.
Recommended that the city council set an annual $5,000 stipend per school committee member, on a roll call with four yes and two no votes recorded.
Approved accepting items 26-681 through 26-683 as a bundle.
discussion: School committee stipend: Concerns were raised about the timing. Others asked whether money was already in the budget, and it is, at $5,000 per member, and could be moved to another line.
Fitchburg High attendance: The principal said about 50% of students missed 10% or more of the school year last year. The school is adding weekly grade-level attendance meetings and more home visits.
Goodrich Academy growth and transport: The principal said 113 students are enrolled and 150 is the target size. He is exploring a van and a driver's license program for students.
South Street attendance: The principal said chronic absenteeism fell from 42% to 36.8% over two years. The school is asking which community supports could close the remaining gap.

ELA curriculum review: The ELA curriculum is up for renewal, and a team is being formed to review options. Curriculum options will be shown between December and January, with information sessions for families.

decision_evidence.quote: I'll make a motion for $5,000. Second. All in favor? Aye. Aye. Opposed? No. One no. Roll call. Can we do a roll call for that? We can. Mr. Stevens? Yes. Mr. Walsh? No. Mrs. Jeffries? Yes. Mrs. England? Yes. Mr. Campbell? Yes. Mr. Santiago? No. Thank you. Motion passes.

The school committee recommends that the city council establish an annual stipend for members of the Pittsburgh School Committee and amount of $5,000 per member and follow the recommendations of the city council for consideration and appropriate action. ... Motion passes.
Make a motion to bundle items 26-681 through items 26-683. Second. All in favor for the bundle? Yes. Aye. Motion to accept the bundle. So moved. Second. All in favor? Aye.
